open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer publisher attribution on import
open_points.text: “written once: the instant it was published and by which principal (M07)” contradicts “Its publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a principal”
open_points.question: What publisher fact does an imported ArtifactPointer carry: an ActingPrincipal, a MigrationClosure reference, or no publisher attribution?
options: Publisher is an ActingPrincipal for every pointer
Publisher is either an ActingPrincipal or the MigrationClosure
Imported pointers have no publisher attribution
open_points.default_guess: Use either an ActingPrincipal or the MigrationClosure, following the explicit import exception.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for agent-authority reads
open_points.text: “No entry is written for ... any read” contradicts “Whether refused attempts and agent-authority reads leave an entry is State 2's”
open_points.question: Does any successful agent-authority read create an AuditEntry, or are all reads excluded as R0-58 and the action list state?
options: No successful read creates an AuditEntry
Only specified agent-authority reads create AuditEntries
open_points.default_guess: No successful read creates an AuditEntry.

open_points.subject: Audit entries for refused attempts
open_points.text: “One significant change of state” and “Registry's own record of its accepted changes” conflict with “the outcome (accepted; whether refused attempts are recorded is settled in State 2)”
open_points.question: Can a refused attempt create an AuditEntry even though it causes no accepted state change, and if so which refused actions are included and what outcomes may the model carry?
options: Only accepted significant changes create AuditEntries
Every refused attempt creates an AuditEntry
Only a declared subset of refused attempts creates AuditEntries
open_points.default_guess: Only accepted significant changes create AuditEntries, following R0-58.

open_points.subject: Project projections after anonymisation
open_points.text: “The project card ('read a project'): M01 with its object, rooms and revision; the archived date for an archived project” and the unconditional `context` and agent-projection bullets conflict with M01's “An anonymised project ... keeps ... nothing else” and R0-62's rule that those reads answer that it was erased
open_points.question: Are the project-card, context and agent-projection definitions limited to non-anonymised projects, with an anonymised project returning only the erased answer?
options: The projection bullets apply only to non-anonymised projects
An anonymised project still returns those projections with missing facts
Each projection has a different anonymised-project behavior
open_points.default_guess: Limit those projections to non-anonymised projects and return the erased answer for an anonymised project.
